review_mode: Read-only reconciliation of recorded evidence; no model calls, browser reruns, primary rescoring or frozen artifact edits.

findings.detail: Counts independently recomputed from per-run rows and per-journey records agree with the stored summary. All six planned cases and both arms remain in the denominator; no duplicate case-arm records or missing journeys were found.

The original audit records nine passing journeys and one change-and-return failure: a 2000 ms Locator.fill timeout at #second-quantity. The separate unchanged-source, zero-new-model-call replay records the same return sequence passing with matching values. Its before/after primary-audit hash equals the currently observed primary-audit hash. The original 5/6 score must remain; this evidence does not establish a pricing-logic defect or an OS-level cause.

The stored boundary finding matches parent-directory text inside a PowerShell here-string written to card/spec.md. The referenced ../card-web/index.html and ../testdata paths are README-style links in the written content, not an observed private-file read in that command. The frozen contaminated label remains untouched. Independently, this row has eight monetary mismatch journeys, so excluding that guard interpretation would not turn the case into a business pass.

The 11364.594-second row spans 09:49:45 to 12:59:09 UTC and dominates direct-arm total elapsed time. These scoped artifacts do not identify whether the long interval was OS sleep, interruption, process stall or another cause. Do not attribute the aggregate elapsed-time difference to the intent module or claim a speed benefit.

The development decision is timestamped 09:26:16 UTC and records zero primary test model runs. The first held-out rows start at 09:26:26 UTC. The decision preserves the original development score and labels the focused regression separately. This checks the available recorded sequence, not unobserved human access to task definitions.

recommended_contribution_claim: Designed a source-derived quotation benchmark and a question-driven requirements acquisition plus context-delivery method. Under the same Core model and repair budget, the six held-out synthetic business configurations improved from 1/6 to 5/6 complete delivery in the recorded paired run; four cases improved and none reversed. This is preliminary evidence of improved requirements fidelity, not proof of general salesperson productivity.
limits: Six authored held-out requirements from one vendor's public rule families and scripted sellers are not real customer interviews or deployments.
The treatment includes acquiring missing facts and delivering structured/verbatim context, so the result cannot isolate wording quality or model intelligence.
The 136 browser journeys are dependent checks within six paired tasks, not 136 independent samples.
The exact paired p-value is 0.125; describe an observed small-sample improvement rather than a statistically established population effect.
Core revisions are equal at one per arm; total CLI calls increase by eleven for clarification. This run does not support a lower-cost, lower-rework or faster claim.
Engineering publication was 6/6 in both arms; the improvement is in final business acceptance after publication, not the UI engineering gate.
Input-boundary safeguards are prompt policy plus retained-tool audit, not operating-system read isolation.
The primary score remains 5/6 even though the separate timeout diagnostic replay passed.
